questions:
1. **Form of the feature.** The issue offers three options (an "Italic" toggle in the style panel, a Ctrl+I shortcut, an italic font). Which ships? *Suggested:* an "Italic" toggle in the properties panel next to the text align control, tooltip "Italic (Ctrl+I)", plus the Ctrl+I / Cmd+I shortcut; no separate italic font.
2. **Scope of italic.** Whole text element, or part of a text? *Suggested:* one property of the whole text element; no partial italic. Ctrl+I while editing with part of the text highlighted toggles italic on the whole element.
3. **Shortcut behavior.** *Suggested:* Ctrl+I / Cmd+I toggles italic on the selected text or the text being edited; with nothing selected (or only non-text shapes selected) it does nothing; the browser's own Ctrl+I action (e.g. Page Info in Firefox) never opens while the canvas has focus; no existing Excalidraw shortcut is taken over.
4. **Where the toggle is shown.** *Suggested:* when a text, a shape with text, an arrow with a label or a sticky note is selected, or the Text tool is active; not shown for shapes without text, nor with nothing selected.
5. **Fonts without italic glyphs.** Hand-drawn (Excalifont), Code (Comic Shanns) and other fonts may have no italic face. *Suggested:* every font shows a slanted text (synthetic slant where there is no real italic face); the toggle is never disabled for a font; CJK, right-to-left text and emoji are slanted too or at least never clipped or garbled.
6. **Mixed selection.** *Suggested:* with several texts selected and only some italic, the toggle shows as not pressed; one click makes all italic, a second click removes italic from all.
7. **Default for new text.** *Suggested:* the last chosen italic value becomes the default for new text, like font family and size.
8. **Size and wrapping.** *Suggested:* the text box widens so the slanted last character is never clipped; text inside a shape re-wraps to the shape width and the shape grows taller if needed, width unchanged; an arrow label stays at the middle of the arrow; a sticky note's auto-fit takes italic into account.
9. **Editing.** *Suggested:* while a text is being edited, the editor shows italic the same as the canvas, so the text does not jump when editing starts or ends.
10. **Copies, styles, history.** *Suggested:* copy/paste styles, Ctrl+C then Ctrl+V, Ctrl+D, Alt+drag and library items carry italic; one italic change is undone with a single undo and restored with redo.
11. **Leaving the session.** *Suggested:* italic survives reload, a saved .excalidraw file, PNG and SVG export (SVG shows italic on a computer without the fonts), copy as PNG/SVG and live collaboration; an older Excalidraw version opens a file with italic text without error and shows it upright.
12. **Interface language and small screens.** *Suggested:* in other locales a missing "Italic" translation falls back to English, never an empty label or raw key; the toggle fits a 375 px wide properties panel in the mobile layout and works by tap.
answers:
Answers from the product owner, relayed by the user; for questions they do not cover, the user accepted the suggested answer.

1. **Form of the feature.** (user) A toggle in the properties panel and the Ctrl+I / Cmd+I shortcut; italic is one property per text element; there is no separate italic font. (accepted suggestion) The toggle is labelled "Italic", sits next to the text align control and has the tooltip "Italic (Ctrl+I)".
2. **Scope of italic.** (user) Whole text element only; no partial italic. Bold is out of scope. (accepted suggestion) Ctrl+I while editing with part of the text highlighted toggles italic on the whole element.
3. **Shortcut behavior.** (accepted suggestion) Ctrl+I / Cmd+I toggles italic on the selected text or the text being edited; with nothing selected, or only shapes without text selected, it does nothing; the browser's own Ctrl+I action (e.g. Page Info in Firefox) never opens while the canvas has focus; no existing Excalidraw shortcut is taken over.
4. **Where the toggle is shown.** (accepted suggestion) When a text, a shape with text, an arrow with a label or a sticky note is selected, or the Text tool is active; not shown for shapes without text, nor with nothing selected.
5. **Fonts without italic glyphs.** (user) Synthetic oblique is allowed; text stays readable and unclipped in Latin, Cyrillic, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, Hebrew (right to left), emoji and mixed scripts; text direction and alignment are unchanged by italic. (accepted suggestion) Every font shows slanted text when italic is on, and the toggle is never disabled for any font.
6. **Mixed selection.** (accepted suggestion) With several texts selected and only some italic, the toggle shows as not pressed; one click makes all italic, a second click removes italic from all.
7. **Default for new text.** (user) The last italic value becomes the default for new text.
8. **Size and wrapping.** (accepted suggestion) The text box widens so the slanted last character is never clipped; text inside a shape re-wraps to the shape width and the shape grows taller if needed, width unchanged; an arrow label stays at the middle of the arrow; a sticky note's auto-fit takes italic into account.
9. **Editing.** (accepted suggestion) While a text is being edited, the editor shows italic the same as the canvas, so the text does not jump when editing starts or ends.
10. **Copies, styles, history.** (accepted suggestion) Copy/paste styles, Ctrl+C then Ctrl+V, Ctrl+D, Alt+drag and library items carry italic; one italic change is undone with a single undo and restored with redo. (user) Color and opacity changes keep italic.
11. **Leaving the session.** (accepted suggestion) Italic survives reload, a saved .excalidraw file, PNG and SVG export (SVG shows italic on a computer without the fonts), copy as PNG/SVG and live collaboration; an older Excalidraw version opens a file with italic text without error and shows it upright.
12. **Interface language and small screens.** (accepted suggestion) In other locales a missing "Italic" translation falls back to English, never an empty label or raw key; the toggle fits a 375 px wide properties panel in the mobile layout and works by tap.
